instructions.title: MiniHack: Eat
text: You're hungry. Walk onto the food, then eat it in
two steps:  press  SPACE  to eat, then  A  to confirm.
ARROWS       move  N / S / W / E
A / S        move diagonally  NW / NE     (A = 'yes')
Z / C        move diagonally  SW / SE     (C = 'no')
SPACE  then  A   eat the food you're standing on
